reason: The get_tasks implementation normalizes a project root, initializes Task Master core, calls n.tasks.list(...), and returns the resulting tasks and stats as JSON. That establishes returning project/task data from local or configured Task Master storage into the agent context, so SECRET is supported. The returned task fields come from task storage and can contain user/project-controlled content, so UNTRUSTED is supported. The cited get_tasks path does not show arbitrary host command/code execution, nor does it send agent-supplied data to an attacker-chosen destination; it only returns data to the MCP caller, so HOSTEXEC and SINK are not supported.
